summary: Frontend visual redesign testing - 'Clinical Futurist Premium' dark theme verification. All major features PASS: Onboarding 5 slides, Login page, Dashboard, Tab navigation all render correctly with dark theme. Minor issue: Icon fonts render as boxes (known Expo web limitation).

issues: Health category card backgrounds use rgba(255,255,255,0.45) which appears as light gray glass effect - acceptable for glass design but could be darker
Icon fonts (Ionicons) render as unicode boxes on Expo web - known limitation documented by main agent, not a bug
